description: JmapCaller has server_start: Instant which holds AppState::start_time — the server process start time. The field name suggests per-request timing. A contributor reading JmapCaller would assume server_start is when the current request started, leading to incorrect use (e.g. request age calculation). Rename to server_uptime_start or process_start_time to be unambiguous.
title: JmapCaller.server_start is Instant (server uptime), not a per-request timestamp — misleading field name
